Notice to all staff: Nordwind Appliances is recalling the NWK-2200 cordless kettle (batch codes ending 4471–4479) sold through our office supplies catalogue between March and June. The base connector can overheat if the kettle is left on the dock while empty. Please unplug and set aside any affected units in your department kitchen and log them via the Facilities ticket form under 'Recall — Kettle'. Replacements are expected within ten working days.

intent.requested_action: set aside affected kettles and log them in the Facilities ticket form

items.text:
Hi Dana,

Ahead of the phone upgrade window opening on 3 November, here's what the IT asset team needs from you. Your current handset (Galaxy A52, asset tag IT-PH-0912) is eligible for refresh; the replacement model this cycle is the Pixel 8a with a standard 128GB configuration. Drop-off for the old device happens at the Service Desk on the 4th or 5th, after which your data is wiped and the asset is retired. If you'd rather keep the A52 for another year, just reply to the ticket and we'll skip you this cycle. Questions? The helpdesk chatbot "Ask IT" can look up your asset tag and eligibility status.

Thanks,
Priya Raman
IT Asset Coordinator

Finance Ops Weekly — Issue 214

This week: the Q3 expense submission cut-off is Friday 18 October at 17:00, and anything submitted after that rolls into Q4. Reminder that receipts over £75 need a manager sign-off attached before the finance bot will process the claim — claims missing this step are held in the queue and not rejected, so there's no need to resubmit. The travel policy refresh (v6.2) is now live in the policy library; the main change is that rail travel is now bookable up to 14 days ahead rather than 7. Finally, congratulations to the AP team for clearing the backlog — average processing time is down to 2.1 days.

Hi team,

A few notes from this morning's HR systems sync.

The recall of the older badge printers (the HID-FP40 units in reception and both loading bays) is now complete — thanks to everyone who coordinated the swap. If you still see one of the affected units in a satellite office, raise it under the 'Facilities — Recall' queue rather than emailing the vendor directly, so we keep a single audit trail.

The self-service chatbot on the HR portal went live last week. Early numbers look good: around 340 conversations, mostly password resets and leave-balance questions, with an 82% resolution rate. Please keep using the feedback button at the end of each chat — the vendor reviews that data fortnightly and it's shaping the next release.

On the phone upgrade: the confirmed cycle for Q4 covers Android handsets only. iOS refreshes move to Q1 next year, pending the MDM migration. Managers, if you have staff on the A52 or A54 who are due, the eligibility report is in the shared drive under IT Assets / Refresh 2024Q4.
Ticket HR-9921 (resolved): employee asked if the benefits chatbot can explain the difference between the standard and enhanced dental tiers; linked to the benefits summary PDF and closed.

Hi all,

As part of the phone upgrade cycle, please note that the automated provisioning tool will begin pushing new device profiles on Monday morning. Staff who are upgrading should back up photos and personal files to OneDrive by Sunday evening — the provisioning tool wipes the old handset as part of the swap, and while we do take a backup, the last one is from the 28th. If you're not upgrading this cycle, nothing changes for you.

ER case note (HR-4417): On 9 October the employee reported that a customer-service page they were reading displayed a pop-up urging visitors to paste their credentials into a "security verification" box. The employee closed the page without entering anything and contacted the service desk. No credentials were exposed. The phishing team has been notified and the page added to the blocklist; an awareness note will go out in next week's newsletter.
